rendered: The paper "Anode-Free Sodium Battery through in Situ Plating of Sodium Metal" by Adam P. Cohn, Nitin Muralidharan, et al. measures the sodium nucleation overpotential on aluminum current collectors. The paper finds that the sodium nucleation overpotential on a bare aluminum current collector is 19 mV, while the sodium nucleation overpotential on an aluminum current collector with a carbon layer is 12 mV, a reduction of 7 mV.
